006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.AbstractCodedMetapathException;
009
010/**
011 * FORG: Exceptions related to argument types.
012 */
013public class InvalidArgumentFunctionException
014    extends AbstractCodedMetapathException {
015
016  /**
017   * <a href=
018   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORG0001">err:FORG0001</a>: A
019   * general-purpose error raised when casting, if a cast between two datatypes is
020   * allowed in principle, but the supplied value cannot be converted: for example
021   * when attempting to cast the string "nine" to an integer.
022   */
023  public static final int INVALID_VALUE_FOR_CAST = 1;
024  /**
025   * <a href=
026   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORG0002">err:FORG0002</a>:
027   * Raised when either argument to fn:resolve-uri is not a valid URI/IRI.
028   */
029  public static final int INVALID_ARGUMENT_TO_RESOLVE_URI = 2;
030  /**
031   * <a href=
032   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORG0003">err:FORG0003</a>:
033   * Raised by <a href=
034   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-zero-or-one">fn:zero-or-one</a>
035   * if the supplied value contains more than one item.
036   *
037   */
038  public static final int INVALID_ARGUMENT_ZERO_OR_ONE = 3;
039  /**
040   * <a href=
041   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORG0004">err:FORG0005</a>:
042   * Raised by <a href=
043   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-one-or-more">fn:one-or-more</a>
044   * if the supplied value is an empty sequence.
045   */
046  public static final int INVALID_ARGUMENT_ONE_OR_MORE = 4;
047  /**
048   * <a href=
049   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORG0005">err:FORG0005</a>:
050   * Raised by <a href=
051   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-exactly-one">fn:exactly-one</a>
052   * if the supplied value is not a singleton sequence.
053   *
054   */
055  public static final int INVALID_ARGUMENT_EXACTLY_ONE = 5;
056  /**
057   * <a href=
058   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORG0006">err:FORG0006</a>:
059   * Raised by functions such as
060   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-max">fn:max</a>,
061   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-min">fn:min</a>,
062   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-avg">fn:avg</a>,
063   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-sum">fn:sum</a> if
064   * the supplied sequence contains values inappropriate to this function.
065   */
066  public static final int INVALID_ARGUMENT_TYPE = 6;
067
068  /**
069   * <a href=
070   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORG0008">err:FORG0008</a>:
071   * Raised by <a href=
072   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-dateTime">fn:dateTime</a> if
073   * the two arguments both have timezones and the timezones are different.
074   */
075  public static final int DATE_TIME_INCONSISTENT_TIMEZONE = 8;
076
077  /**
078   * the serial version UUID.
079   */
080  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
081
082  /**
083   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
084   * and {@code cause}.
085   *
086   * @param code
087   *          the error code value
088   * @param message
089   *          the exception message
090   * @param cause
091   *          the original exception cause
092   */
093  public InvalidArgumentFunctionException(int code, String message, Throwable cause) {
094    super(code, message, cause);
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
099   * and no cause.
100   *
101   * @param code
102   *          the error code value
103   * @param message
104   *          the exception message
105   */
106  public InvalidArgumentFunctionException(int code, String message) {
107    super(code, message);
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, no message, and
112   * the {@code cause}.
113   *
114   * @param code
115   *          the error code value
116   * @param cause
117   *          the original exception cause
118   */
119  public InvalidArgumentFunctionException(int code, Throwable cause) {
120    super(code, cause);
121  }
122
123  @Override
124  public String getCodePrefix() {
125    return "FORG";
126  }
127}
